owner: original Powerhouse SEO Order Engine / BG169
root_cause: Original triage score primarily used estimated monthly volume, user-assigned commercial fit, GSC impressions/zero-click quotient. Missing GSC fields were cast as zero and Google Ads competition/CPC, organic keyword difficulty, real ranking and independent external evidence were not separate scored factors. Broad DataForSEO Keyword Ideas can return unrelated high-volume terms.
impact: Risk of incorrect keyword priority and false CTR or lead assumptions, including user questions about DataForSEO and independent external opportunities.
fix: Replace existing original triage ranker score with evidence-weighted 100-point pure model; keep original hard provider date/business fit/canonical owner gate, add source coverage, observed vs unobserved GSC, distinct organic difficulty vs paid Ads, measured trend, dated HTTPS independent market evidence, recommended original next action, and transparent confidence.
prevention: Every source gets timestamp, country, language, provider ID, and one canonical commercial intent owner before action
Google Ads competition and paid CPC never proxy organic keyword difficulty, ranking, leads or revenue
GSC query/page absent means NOT_MEASURED, never zero clicks; GSC position >30 means relevance/authority work before CTR
Fresh independent evidence must be dated HTTPS and distinct domain, community chatter never proves a market event
Human AI referrals and provider-cited AI answers are separate from AI search-volume estimates
Any source-to-consumer handoff without processed ACK remains owned/open; no secondary publisher or mass closure
